justification: No: the exact package contains only `ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/Dialogs.java`, and that class is referenced by 5 other UI classes (`JITWatchUI`, `MainConfigStage`, `SandboxStage`, `EditorPane`, `TriView`). Its only internal dependencies are `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.util.UserInterfaceUtil` and `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.core.JITWatchConstants` (shown at lines 24-26 of `Dialogs.java`), and those are broadly reused elsewhere in the repo (31 files import `UserInterfaceUtil`; 135 files import `JITWatchConstants`). That is not evidence of the package depending on a less-stable internal package.
